info.title: Palace HTTP API
info.description: Owner-scoped Palace API. Schema describes wire structure, not authorization or transactional guarantees. Body limits use injected ImportLimits (default raw history 8 MiB); HTTP limit is bytes * 6 + 64 KiB. Media uploads instead use the deployment media limit (default 50 MiB) + 64 KiB; article imports use the deployment article limit (default 256 MiB). UTF-8 byte limits, nonblank strings and canonical cursor upper bounds are enforced by the server. Native extractor errors may be text/plain. No deployment credentials or environment metadata are included.

AccessToken.description: An access token as listed; only the masked form ever appears after creation.

masked.description: `palace_pat_`, the first and last four random characters, and `*` for every other one.

note.description: What the token is used for; trimmed, 1 to 100 characters.

content.description: Markdown body; its embedded files are `/api/media/<id>` addresses listed in `media`.

date.description:
The publish date as an edit takes it back: `YYYY-MM-DD` when only a day was given,
otherwise RFC 3339 at the deployment's offset.

id.description: Equal to the article's moment id.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the import, the article's place on the timeline.

published_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the publish date.

ArticleImportFields.description: The `article` part of an import, sent before any file.

author.description: Optional; blank means none; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

content.description:
Markdown body, at most 4 MiB. Embedded files are inline images `![alt](media:<name>)`;
the server replaces each address with `/api/media/<id>`. Never editable afterwards.

date.description: Publish date: `YYYY-MM-DD` (midnight in the deployment's zone) or RFC 3339 with an offset.

title.description: Nonblank after trimming; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; kept as sent.

url.description:
Absolute http(s) URL of the original article, at most 2048 bytes; identifies the article
within the owner, compared byte for byte.

ArticleImportForm.description: One `article` part, then one `file` part per embedded file.

article.description: JSON text of ArticleImportFields; must be the first part.

file.description:
Embedded files. Each filename is the `<name>` the body uses, 1-128 characters of
`[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, unique within the import; the part's Content-Type is recorded. Every
file must be embedded and every embedded name must have a file.

date.description: The publish date as written back by the server; see Article.date.

published_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the publish date.

site.description: The URL's host without `www.`, shown where there is no author.

ArticleMedia.description: One embedded file; the type tells an image from a video.

ArticleMoment.description: An article moment: the article on the day it was imported.

id.description: Moment id, equal to the article id.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the import.

site.description: The URL's host without `www.`, shown where there is no author.

url.description: Another article of the owner already at this URL is a conflict.

ConversationMoment.description: A conversation moment is one path of a conversation tree.

excerpt.description: Up to the first two messages of the path as plain text, each at most 120 characters plus an ellipsis.

id.description: Moment id, equal to the path id.

message_count.description: Messages from the root to the end of this path.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

ConversationPage.description: One page of the 摘星 conversation list.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null on the last page.

total.description: Number of paths the owner has, regardless of `q`.

created_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds assigned by the database.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

original_link.description: A controlled external link, never fetched by the server.

title.description: The title of this source session; other paths of the tree have their own.

updated_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds assigned by the database.

CreatedAccessToken.description: A newly created token, the only response that ever carries its full value.

token.description: The full token for `Authorization: Bearer`; it cannot be retrieved again.

Cursor.description: Canonical decimal string in 0..=9223372036854775807; the domain checks the numeric upper bound.

login.description: /auth/login for authentication_required; the empty string for other errors. Always present.

FileImport.description: A multipart transport view of TextImport; each metadata part is UTF-8 text (at most 1024 bytes).

history.description: Raw history bytes; default limit 8 MiB. File or text part accepted; filename/MIME ignored.

occurred_at.description: Text parsed as i64 epoch milliseconds in -62135596800000..=253402300799999.

session_id.description: 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; a single literal source identity segment.

JottingChange.description: The current state of one jotting changed after the cursor: its content, or its deletion.

JottingChanges.description:
One page of the jotting feed. Advance the cursor to `next` in the same local transaction that
applies the page; `next` also passes tombstones a first sync leaves out.

JottingOverview.description: Counts behind the left column of the 回响 page; days are the deployment's local days.

daily.description: One entry per local day from `from` through today, empty days included.

days.description: Local days with at least one jotting.

tags.description: Every tag, most used first, then by name.

JottingPage.description: One page of live jottings, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null on the last page.

total.description: Jottings matching `tag` and `q` across all pages.

JottingRecall.description: Today's recall pile: the same jottings in the same order all day while they are unchanged.

jottings.description: At most five jottings created before today.

JottingUpload.description:
A jotting created offline. The client generates the id and keeps it across retries; the
same upload sent again is recognized, a different one under a used id is refused.

body.description: Markdown, at most 1 MiB; leading blank lines are dropped.

ListedJotting.description: A live jotting as the 回响 page shows it.

pending.description: The file sits under `inbox/`, waiting for the agent to sort it.

logged_out.description: True after the local revocation has committed, including when external revocation is pending.

Media.description: A stored media file. Its id is the only reference to keep; storage locations never leave the server.

content_type.description: Lowercase `type/subtype` declared by the uploading part, or application/octet-stream.

file_name.description: Name the client gave the file, for display only; null when none was given.

id.description: Server-generated UUID v7; stable for the life of the file.

MediaUploadForm.description: Exactly one part named `file`; any other or repeated part is rejected.

file.description: 1 byte to the deployment limit (default 50 MiB). The part's Content-Type and filename are recorded.

created_order.description: Ordering integer, not a timestamp; i64 values are not generally lossless JS numbers.

parent_message_id.description: Always present; root messages carry null.

toc_line.description:
The opening words of `content` as plain text, at most a few dozen characters, for the

idempotency_key.description: Nonblank; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, scoped to the owner.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

session_id.description: 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; same source identity validation as initial import.

title.description: Title of the new path. Nonblank after trimming; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the note's frontmatter `date`.

NoteListItem.description: One note as the list shows it.

NotePage.description: One page of the 摘星 note list.

next_cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page; null on the last page.

source.description: Source of the whole conversation; it cascades to every path.

title.description: Title of the addressed path. Nonblank after trimming; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; no normalization.

Record.description: Independent opaque records; this protocol cannot modify imported conversation trees.

body.description: Required but accepts any JSON value, including null; no domain object shape is imposed.

updatedAt.description: Client Unix epoch milliseconds; full i64 range, not guaranteed lossless in JS number.

TextImport.description: Original history JSON is a string here, not an embedded message array.

history.description:
Nonempty role/content array encoded as text. Default limits: 8 MiB, 10000 messages,
1 MiB per content, depth 32. Extra message fields are ignored; content is preserved.

idempotency_key.description: Nonblank after trimming; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, scoped to the owner.

occurred_at.description: User-selected Unix epoch milliseconds, calendar years 0001 through 9999.

session_id.description: 1..512 UTF-8 bytes; one source path segment, no whitespace, controls or /\\?#%:.

title.description: Nonblank after trimming; preserve the original value; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

base_head_message_id.description: Required for delta and rejected for full: the path head the client saw, compared under the write lock.

history.description:
Original JSON text; TextImport limits apply. Full: the whole existing history plus appended
messages. Delta: only the new messages, placed after the current head.

history_mode.description: How history relates to the path; the server never infers it from the content.

idempotency_key.description: Nonblank; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes, scoped to the owner.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds selected by the user.

title.description: Replaces the path title. Nonblank after trimming; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

UploadedJotting.description:
An accepted upload and the version it is published under; on a retry, the jotting's current
version, which may belong to a later edit or a deletion.

access_token.description: Owner access token `palace_pat_…` for CLI and service callers; created and deleted only through a browser session. Business operations only; sends no cookie and needs no Origin. Any Authorization header disables the session cookie for that request.

login_flow.name: __Host-palace-login
login_flow.description: Browser-bound one-time login flow; validated together with query state before exchanging code.

session.name: __Host-palace-session
session.description: Production browser session; Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/. Business handlers receive a server-resolved owner. Local fixed-user mode is a development-only boundary.
